summary: Iteration 5: Full E2E testing of the new Support/Contact feature (backend + frontend). Backend: 23/23 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_support.py covering /support/upload (auth, valid image, non-image rejection, >5MB rejection), /support/files/{id} (Bearer header, ?auth= query for , owner/admin/other-user/anonymous/404 cases), /support/tickets (create with/without screenshot, foreign screenshot rejection, mine-only sorted-desc, auth), and /admin/support/tickets (list, status_filter, non-admin 403, PATCH with reviewed_by/reviewed_at, invalid status 400, unknown 404, non-admin PATCH 403, user sees admin reply). Frontend: Playwright verified /support page (username prefilled+disabled, subject/amount/message/file inputs work), attach → 'Attached' green check → remove → re-attach → submit flow shows ticket in my-tickets-list with open chip + View screenshot link. Profile → support link works. Admin: /admin/support opens from sidebar, all 4 tabs render, ticket-row opens modal with subject/user/amount/message and inline screenshot (naturalWidth>0 confirms ?auth= works). Setting status=resolved + reply + Save PATCHes ticket, closes modal, ticket moves from 'open' tab to 'resolved' tab, and the user's /support page shows the admin reply in a card-raised box with resolved chip.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py MAX_UPLOAD_MB=5 correctly enforced after reading full body — for a public-facing endpoint consider streaming size check to avoid buffering large payloads in memory. Not blocking.

server.py /support/files/{file_id} manually parses Bearer/?auth= token then reuses JWT_SECRET/JWT_ALG — good; correctly returns 401 for anonymous, 403 for non-owner-non-admin, 404 for unknown. Owner check uses caller['id'] == rec['user_id']. Good.

server.py SupportTicketUpdateIn.status is plain str (no Enum), validated manually inside handler (returns 400). Acceptable; would be slightly cleaner as Literal['open','in_progress','resolved','rejected'] but current behavior matches spec exactly.

server.py admin PATCH allows admin_reply to be null/None — no lower bound. If admin blanks a reply, previous reply is overwritten with None. Confirm this is intended (currently the frontend admin modal pre-fills reply with existing t.admin_reply, so accidental blanking is unlikely).
Support.jsx amount input has min='0' but accepts empty string; server accepts Optional[float]. Consistent.
Support.jsx & admin/Support.jsx both read token via localStorage.getItem('aerox_token') for — matches app-wide auth storage key.
Support.jsx server rejects non-image, but client only blocks based on MIME type prefix (^image/). server extension check is authoritative — good defense in depth.
server.py support_files insert stores original_filename verbatim (could be attacker-controlled) — safe as we only display/download via storage_path (uuid path).
server.py `db.support_files.insert_one(dict(rec))` — rec already dict; dict() copy is harmless but unnecessary. Minor style.
Admin Support.jsx tab list matches backend enum exactly; no dead states. Good.
